audience: online sellers and fulfillment teams who manage orders and inventory in Order Desk

useCases.title: Find orders in a folder from the last days
useCases.text: The AI lists orders in a date range and folder, newest first, with items, addresses, totals, payment and shipments. It shows what needs action.

useCases.title: Show one order with its items and shipments
useCases.text: The AI opens an order and reads its line items and the shipments recorded against it, with carrier, tracking number and dates.

useCases.title: Find inventory items that are low in stock
useCases.text: The AI searches inventory by SKU or name and lists the items with their stock count, so you see what is below a level you choose.

useCases.title: Add tracking to an order and move it
useCases.text: The AI records a shipment with carrier and tracking number on an order, then moves the order to another folder. Folder rules may send e-mail or call fulfillment services.

useCases.title: Create or change an order
useCases.text: The AI creates an order, adds an item or a history note to one, or changes order fields. History entries cannot be edited or removed.

useCases.title: Update the stock count of an inventory item
useCases.text: The AI finds an inventory item by SKU or name and changes its stock count.
